newsitem.title: GERMANY: Weekly German grain intervention offers detailed.
newsitem.headline: Weekly German grain intervention offers detailed.

text.p: Sales offers into German grain intervention stores in the November-May 1996/97 season continue to lag behind those in the same 1995/96 period, figures from the state grain intervention board BLE showed.
Volumes on January 24 totalled 419,367 tonnes compared with 1,293,517 tonnes a year earlier.
The figure described volumes accepted, but not yet delivered to stores, by the close last Friday.
Free market prices were mostly well above the January intervention buying-in price of 238.10 marks a tonne, traders said.
